about.name: Suresh Koragana
about.summary: Data Engineer specializing in building and optimizing scalable PySpark-based data pipelines. Experienced in improving data quality, resolving complex data inconsistencies, and delivering reliable data solutions across AWS and Azure environments. Strong focus on performance, scalability, and enabling data-driven decision making.

education.degree: B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering

details: Designed and optimized scalable Spark pipelines processing 12TB+ of data, reducing runtime by 40% and enabling dashboards to refresh 6 hours earlier.
Led end-to-end migration of legacy SQL workflows to distributed PySpark pipelines, improving batch execution time by 3× and enhancing scalability.
Built a reusable data quality and anomaly detection framework, reducing manual validation efforts by 30% and improving reliability of analytics outputs.
Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into efficient data models and ETL workflows aligned with analytics needs.
Engineered robust ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting 100+ datasets, enabling downstream analytics for a Fortune 500 client.
Implemented RapidFuzz-based fuzzy matching on insurance identifiers, resolving inconsistencies in complex datasets and improving entity resolution by 26% to support key business decisions.
Migrated legacy SQL and Pandas workflows to PySpark, reducing processing time by 85% through distributed execution.
Developed scalable ingestion frameworks to process raw CSV data into structured, partitioned datasets using PySpark.
Owned end-to-end pipeline development from ingestion to validation and delivery, reducing manual effort by 70%.
Automated and streamlined ETL workflows using Autosys, eliminating 90% of manual interventions and improving SLA adherence.

projects.name: Cloud-Native Real-Time Data Engineering Pipeline
projects.description: Built a fully automated real-time data pipeline using Kafka, PySpark, and AWS to process streaming stock market data.
highlights: Implemented Kafka-based streaming to capture real-time stock tick data at scale.
Enabled fault-tolerant ingestion with checkpointing, partitioning, and scalable storage on S3.
Designed extensible architecture supporting both batch and streaming (Lakehouse model).
